summary: Stripe webhook: subscription period end is now taken from the subscription item's current_period_end instead of subscription.ended_at (null for active subscriptions, so paying users were stored with a 1970 end date and never counted as Pro); also handles checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, and wraps both database updates in try/catch that only logs, still answering Stripe 200. Billing button loading state cleaned up; removes explicit billing_address_collection 'auto' (Stripe's default); adds a local-only .cursor/mcp.json.

statements.why: Header count matches the one real problem below.

statements.text: If saving to your database fails in your Stripe webhook (src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts), the error is caught and Stripe is still told it worked, so it won't try again. A customer can pay and never get what they paid for. Answer with an error (status 500) so Stripe retries.
statements.why: webhooks/stripe/route.ts: both updates wrapped in try/catch that only console.errors, then `return new Response(null, { status: 200 })`.
